intro.h2: The contractor Pottstown neighbors call back
paragraphs: Independence Renovations LLC. handles bathroom remodeling Pottstown homeowners return to again and again. Their Facebook page says they specialize in bathroom and kitchen renovations, and the tiled walk-in shower above, with its pebble floor and glass door, shows the kind of finish Nick puts in.

The common thread in the reviews is repeat work. One customer had Nick build a deck, tile a bathroom and remodel the kitchen. Another had him do every job in both his house and his barbershop. A third says he would not work with another contractor now. Reviewers call Nick super nice, professional and on time.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Pottstown and the rest of the house

items.name: Bathroom remodeling and tile
items.blurb: Bathrooms are a core specialty. Nick handles tile, plumbing and carpentry himself, so a remodel like the walk-in shower shown here, with large-format wall tile, a pebble floor and a frameless glass door, stays with one contractor from start to finish.

image.alt: Tiled walk-in shower with pebble floor, linear drain and glass door

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchen renovations are the other half of what their Facebook page says they specialize in. One Google reviewer had Nick remodel the kitchen after he had already built the deck and tiled the bathroom. Call to talk through layout, cabinets, counters and floors.

items.name: Decks and covered patios
items.blurb: Outdoor work shows up in their photos: a painted deck with white railings and a covered patio with a roof, posts and lighting. A Google reviewer listed the deck as one of several projects Nick completed on the same home.

image.alt: Red-painted wood deck with white railings and steps behind a two-story home

items.name: Carpentry, concrete and plumbing
items.blurb: A longtime customer describes Nick as an all-in-one contractor who does carpentry, tile, concrete, remodeling, bathrooms and plumbing. That range means smaller repairs and bigger renovations can be handled by the same person who already knows your house.

image.alt: Covered patio with a metal roof, wood posts and lighting over a wood deck at dusk

items.title: Customers come back
items.text: Reviewers describe multiple projects on the same house and call Nick their go-to. One says he has done all the work in his home and his barbershop.

items.title: One contractor, many trades
items.text: Carpentry, tile, concrete, remodeling, bathrooms and plumbing are all on the list one customer gave. Fewer hand-offs between trades means fewer people to coordinate.

items.title: Finished on time
items.text: A Google review highlight sums up the work as beautiful craftsmanship, professional and complete in a timely manner. Every one of their 7 Google reviews is five stars.

items.title: Open seven days
items.text: Google lists the business as open Monday to Saturday from 6 AM to 8 PM and Sunday from 9 AM to 6 PM, so you can reach them most hours.

about.text: Independence Renovations LLC. is a remodeling company on N Charlotte St in Pottstown, Pennsylvania, where customers work directly with Nick. One customer who has known him his whole life credits Nick's construction background, and says he does it all. On Facebook the company describes itself in its own words: quality craftsmanship, honest pricing, a name you can trust to get the job done right the first time, specializing in bathroom and kitchen renovations. The German shepherd on their logo fits the reviews: loyal customers who keep calling Nick back.
about.owner_role: Contractor named in every captured review; last name and formal title not published

image.alt: Independence Renovations LLC logo with a German shepherd in a dark green shield

process.h2: How a project with Nick works

steps.title: Call or message
steps.text: Call (484) 925-4872 or email Nick with what you want done, whether that is a bathroom, a kitchen, a deck or a repair.

steps.title: Walk through the job
steps.text: Nick looks at the space with you, talks through the work and the materials, and explains how he would handle it.

steps.title: Agree on the price
steps.text: You get a price for the work before it starts. Their Facebook page lists honest pricing as one of the things they stand for.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Nick does the carpentry, tile, plumbing or concrete work the job needs. Reviewers describe the work as professional and completed in a timely manner.

steps.title: Next project
steps.text: Walk through the finished work together. Several of their reviewers went on to hire Nick for another room or project afterward.

faq.h2: Questions about working with Independence Renovations

items.q: What kind of work do you do?
items.a: Their Facebook page says they specialize in bathroom and kitchen renovations. Customers also describe decks, bathroom tile, concrete, carpentry and plumbing. One reviewer calls Nick an all-in-one contractor, so if your project spans several trades, he can usually talk you through all of it in one visit.

Yes. Tile is one of the most mentioned topics in their Google reviews, and their photos include a walk-in shower with large blue-gray wall tile, a pebble mosaic floor and a frameless glass door. Call Nick to talk through the tile and layout you have in mind for your bathroom.

Google lists Independence Renovations as open Monday through Saturday from 6 AM to 8 PM and Sunday from 9 AM to 6 PM. You can call (484) 925-4872 in those hours or email IndependenceRenovationsLLC@gmail.com with photos of your project at any time.

The business is based in Pottstown, and that is the town on its Google and Facebook pages. A longtime customer wrote that Nick will travel anywhere to build relations and show his work. If you live outside Pottstown, call and ask whether your location works.

Every job is different, so Nick looks at the work and gives you a price for it. Their Facebook page says the company stands for quality craftsmanship and honest pricing. Call or email with photos and a short description of what you want to get the conversation started.

final_cta.text: Call Nick at Independence Renovations and talk it through.
